Capture privacy and limits

Captures stay in memory on this PC and are not uploaded. The screenshot is limited to the foreground Slay the Spire 2 window. Other overlapping windows can obscure it. Use borderless/windowed mode. The app never reads process memory, sends game input, or edits files in your game/save folders.

Keep the earlier bridge removed to use normal, unmodded progress. Windows OCR may fail or confuse other counters with HP. Map marking is manual in this preview; unseen rooms, card effects, and enemies are not evaluated.
